title: Lost & Found
sub: Help lost papers and belongings find their way home. Private by design.
lostHint: Post it. We look for matches.
foundHint: Help the owner get it back.
privacy: Your ID numbers are never stored. We keep only a one-way fingerprint.
privacyLong: Private by design. ID numbers become one-way fingerprints. Your phone number is shared only after you approve.
guestHint: Browse as a guest. Nothing you post is tied to a Google account.
signInUnavailable: Sign-in is not available right now
signedOut: Browse the feed. To post or claim, continue as a guest.
emptyFeed: Nothing yet. Post what you lost and we will tell you the moment something matches.
guide: If you lost a document: what to do next
demoStoryHint: Posts a lost TEST passport (Z1234567) in Chennai/Adyar so you can claim the seeded found item.
offline: You are offline. You can still read what is already on this phone.
errorRetry: Could not reach Lost & Found. Try again.
idHint: Sarvam does not store this number. It becomes a one-way fingerprint used only to match.
aadhaarNever: For Aadhaar and similar cards, Sarvam never takes the number. Matching uses the name, place and time instead.
consent: I am 18 or older. I agree that Sarvam may use these details to look for a match. I can delete this post at any time, and it is deleted automatically after 90 days.
noMoney: No rewards or money are asked for in a post. If a finder helps, you can say thanks afterwards. Sarvam never handles money.
questions: Two private questions for the owner
questionsHint: Only the real owner should know the answers. You decide who gets the item.
waitingFinder: Waiting for the finder to review
demoFinderWait: The demo finder replies in a few seconds.
approved: Approved. The finder checked your answers.
shareHow: Share how people can reach you
safety: Meet in a public place, ideally a police station. Never pay before you have the item. Never share OTPs or bank details. Sarvam never asks for money.
thanksSub: Glad it is home. If you want to thank the finder, you can. It is optional.
upiHint: Payment happens in your own UPI app. Sarvam never touches the money.
notLegal: Sarvam connects people; it does not verify identity, ownership or police reports. It is not a substitute for a police complaint.
handToPolice: Hand found IDs to the nearest police station when you can.
noMatch: No match yet. We will tell you when something similar is posted.
checkingSub: Comparing fingerprints, places and dates. This runs in code, not as an AI guess.
hiddenId: Details stay hidden until the finder approves your claim.
needGuest: Continue as guest to post or claim.
guideFoot: Check on the official website. A lost report or e-complaint acknowledgement is often asked for when applying for duplicates.
